_help: The Executive Team on the About page, in this order. Optional per member: photo (path in public/), robot (favourite robot), hobbies (list). Update the year when the committee changes.

members.name: Reece
members.about: Returning President of RobSoc, in the final year of Robotics and AI. A Right to Repair advocate, history lover and a huge nerd.
members.robot: Sophia, the first robot to gain citizenship (in the UAE)

members.name: Dan
members.about: First time as VP, also in the final year of Robotics and AI. Keen to improve his electronics and scratch the itch to make sensible and stupid things alike.

members.name: Ben
members.about: Treasurer of RobSoc and a "mature" second-year Computer Science student. Automating tasks has been a lifelong interest: work smart, not hard!

members.name: Rob
members.about: PhD candidate in Computer Science working on neuroprosthetic technology, with an interest in robotics, tech and building things.
